title: Nameless, Selfless

outfit_card.silhouette: Voluminous dramatic ballgown featuring a corseted off-the-shoulder drop-waist bodice, sculpted crystalline spine cages around the hips, and an expansive cascading floor-sweeping train with asymmetrical draped gathers.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Sheer midnight-blue veil crowned with frosted velvet roses and dimensional lace scalloped edging, paired with a delicate sculpted filigree eye mask ornament.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Plunging off-the-shoulder sweetheart corset bodice crafted from starry brocade, adorned with crystal rib cage overlay, accompanied by sheer Chantilly lace long sleeves extending into fingerless wristlets.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Multilayered navy-and-charcoal glittering tulle skirt with side draping, high slit showing sheer dark stockings, frosted rose clusters at the hip, and pointed stiletto pumps.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Triple-branched antique silver candelabra with glowing candles, translucent crystalline ribcage accents, and fluttering phantom butterfly motifs.
